blocks.text: CEBU, Philippines (October 23, 2026) – Following its debut in scenic Tagaytay, Mango Tree Thai Grill opens its second store location at SM City Cebu. This latest concept by the globally acclaimed Mango Tree group brings Thai street food culture closer to local diners. Mango Tree Thai Grill welcomed invited guests for an exclusive preview on October 23, 2026 at Upper Ground Level of SM City Cebu. Mango Tree Philippines’ executive Thai chef, Chef Chatchawan Suratha, kicked off the event with a live cooking demonstration of Yum Mamuang Moo Yang (a spicy and tangy Thai mango salad with savory lechon)–blending a […]...
